claim: bounded learned cross-substrate relation representation; not unrestricted representation learning or general intelligence

protocol.rotation: train on three substrates; learn relation coordinates from verified transformations; freeze; evaluate fourth; rotate all four
protocol.representation_input: paired raw observable current/target outputs only; no domain identifier or hand-coded MORPHIC signature
protocol.feature_selection: training-data Fisher separation among verified transformation outcomes
protocol.ranking: distance to learned transformation prototypes in standardized learned coordinates
protocol.bit_compaction: sign of each standardized coordinate forms a four-bit Echo key; continuous coordinates retain ranking precision
protocol.training_labels: obtained by executing transformations and retaining only separate-challenge-verified success
